extension.summary: Netflix catalogue and playback for your own account
extension.description: SmoothFlix signs in with your Netflix account, keeps the session on this device, and lists Continue Watching, My List, Trending, New Releases, Popular, TV, Movies and Search. Playback uses inputstream.adaptive and Widevine. The picture stays encrypted until the CDM unlocks it.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Netflix account. Video is played with Kodi inputstream.adaptive and Widevine. No other sources are used.
extension.news: v0.2.0 (2026-11-19)[CR]- Standalone sign-in, catalogue and Widevine playback.[CR]- Removed the Netflix add-on dependency.
